stories.headline: Sánchez clashes with tech giants over social media restrictions for minors
stories.summary: President Sánchez announced a ban on social media access for under-16s, triggering fierce responses from Elon Musk (who called him 'Dirty Sánchez') and Telegram's Pavel Durov, who sent mass warnings to Spanish users. Sánchez responded with 'let the techno-oligarchs bark' quote.

articles.title: Sánchez responde al fundador de Telegram: 'Deja que los tecnoligarcas ladren, Sancho, señal de que cabalgamos'
Sánchez contraataca al CEO de Telegram: 'Ha convertido la plataforma en un espacio de abuso sexual y tráfico de drogas'
Musk arremete contra Sánchez por limitar el acceso a menores a las redes: 'Dirty Sánchez es un tirano y un traidor a los españoles'
Elon Musk arremete contra Pedro Sánchez: 'Tirano y traidor al pueblo de España'

stories.headline: PP wins Aragón elections but loses seats, Vox doubles representation, PSOE suffers major defeat
stories.summary: In the February 8 regional elections, Jorge Azcón's PP won but lost seats and will need Vox support to govern. Vox doubled from 7 to 14 seats, becoming kingmaker. PSOE with candidate Pilar Alegría suffered a significant defeat, losing several seats in what's seen as a blow to Sánchez.

articles.title: El crecimiento de Abascal pone de los nervios a Feijóo y Sánchez tras fracasar en su colonización de las elecciones de Aragón
Vox duplica sus escaños, de 7 a 14, y tiene en su mano el gobierno de Aragón
El PP ganará las elecciones pero dependerá de un Vox al alza y el PSOE cae, según el sondeo de Aragón TV

stories.headline: Feijóo testifies in DANA investigation amid heated exchanges and accusations of lying
stories.summary: PP leader Feijóo appeared before the congressional commission investigating the DANA disaster. His testimony was marked by tense confrontations with ERC's Rufián and Bildu's Matute, who accused him of lying about his communications with former Valencia president Mazón during the floods.

articles.title: Las siete mentiras de Feijóo en la comisión de investigación de la dana en el Congreso
Tenso enfrentamiento entre Feijóo y Rufián en la comisión de la DANA
Feijóo y su lección de grosería

stories.headline: Spanish banks post record profits of 34 billion euros in 2025
stories.summary: Spain's six major banks achieved record combined net profits of 34 billion euros in 2025, up 7% from the previous year. Santander led with 14.1 billion euros in profits. The banking sector benefited from higher interest rates and strong performance in Spain and international markets.

articles.title: La gran banca española gana 34.000 millones en 2025 y logra un nuevo récord
Santander gana un récord de 14.101 millones en 2025, un 12% más
BBVA en modo campeón

stories.headline: Sánchez receives hostile reception with insults during visit to flood-affected Cádiz
stories.summary: President Sánchez was met with angry crowds shouting insults including 'fascist' and 'thief' during his visit to areas affected by Storm Leonardo in Cádiz. Videos showed him avoiding walking on the street and using a car to move around due to the hostile reception from affected residents.

articles.title: Sánchez recibido entre insultos en su visita a las zonas afectadas en Cádiz: 'Fascista, ratero malo'
Los abucheos a un Pedro Sánchez fuertemente escoltado en su llegada a San Roque: '¡Sinvergüenza, carroña!'

stories.headline: CNI ordered to withdraw surveillance during Delcy Rodríguez visit when Ábalos appeared
stories.summary: ABC revealed that CNI agents were surveilling Venezuelan VP Delcy Rodríguez's plane at Madrid airport in January 2020 but were ordered to withdraw when then-Transport Minister Ábalos appeared. WhatsApp chats between agents showed their surprise at the order to cease operations.

articles.title: El chat del CNI, tras la llegada de Delcy: 'Vaya tela con el ministro'
El CNI retiró el dispositivo que vigilaba el avión de Delcy cuando apareció Ábalos en Barajas

stories.headline: Spain accelerates defense spending on military salaries, modernization and intelligence
stories.summary: Spain is increasing defense spending with focus on raising military salaries, modernization programs, and boosting CNI capabilities. The investment includes 436 million for mine countermeasure ships modernization and enhanced cybersecurity capabilities amid growing security threats.

articles.title: España acelera el gasto en defensa y lo destina a subir el salario de los militares, a programas de modernización y al CNI
Defensa destina 436 millones a la modernización integral de los seis cazaminas de la Armada

stories.headline: Yolanda Díaz pushes for worker representation in company boards despite resistance
stories.summary: Labor Minister Yolanda Díaz presented a report proposing that workers get seats on company boards of directors and partial ownership stakes. The initiative faces resistance from Economy Minister Carlos Cuerpo and business groups, with Díaz accusing the Economy Ministry of opposing worker-friendly policies.

articles.title: Yolanda Díaz prepara la colonización de las empresas con castigos a las que no den más poder a los sindicatos
Los expertos de Yolanda Díaz plantean que hasta la mitad de los puestos de los consejos sean para los trabajadores

stories.headline: Feijóo makes verbal gaffes confusing company name eight times during Aragón campaign
stories.summary: PP leader Feijóo repeatedly mispronounced a company name during a campaign visit to meat processor Fribin in Huesca, calling it 'Brifín' eight times. The gaffe drew mockery on social media and was used by Sánchez as campaign ammunition during the final days of the Aragón election campaign.

articles.title: Feijóo se marca otro 'Anotop': vuelve a liarse con una palabra que pronuncia mal hasta en ocho ocasiones
El lapsus de Feijóo en Huesca: visita una empresa y confunde su nombre ocho veces

stories.headline: King Felipe VI celebrates 58th birthday with family at Zarzuela Palace
stories.summary: King Felipe VI marked his 58th birthday on January 30 with a private celebration at Zarzuela Palace with Queen Letizia and their daughters. International media commented on the King's elegant appearance, with some publications highlighting his style and physical fitness.

articles.title: Así celebró Felipe VI su cumpleaños: te contamos su plan familiar y cómo se cuida a sus 58
La celebración del 58 cumpleaños de Felipe VI: en Zarzuela y en compañía de la reina Sofía

stories.headline: PP councilwoman insults Sánchez at Teruel rally, Feijóo condemns incident
stories.summary: A PP councilwoman from Valencia interrupted a Sánchez campaign rally in Teruel shouting 'son of a bitch,' causing a stir. PP leader Feijóo later condemned the incident when pressed by journalists and opposition parties who demanded his response to the insult.

articles.title: Una concejal del PP interrumpe el mitin de Sánchez en Teruel con insultos
Feijóo asegura que 'por supuesto' condena el insulto de la concejal del PP a Sánchez en un mitin

stories.headline: European 'Bizum' payment system launches allowing instant transfers across 13 countries
stories.summary: Spain's Bizum payment system and its European counterparts launched interoperability across 13 countries, allowing instant mobile payments between users in different European nations. The system will serve over 130 million users and represents a European alternative to US payment giants.

articles.title: El Bizum europeo ya es una realidad: así podrás enviar dinero al instante entre 13 países
Los más de 130 millones de usuarios de 'bizums' europeos podrán enviarse dinero este año
